notes.title: NEW CONTENT!!
notes.notes: [img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1820020053379477271/FB956E45EC855DAE06C1B2ADE0EBB8721C8DC6D8/[/img] The new dungeons and PvP map will test your ability to jump over enemy attacks and terrain. The new abilities add a lot more depth, allowing you to tear through enemies and support your teammates more than ever.

notes.title: New Feature | Rebinding Keys
notes.notes:
[b]New Feature[/b]
You can now rebind your abilities to different buttons on your keyboard/controller.

[b]Bug Fix[/b]
The matchmaking server is working again.

notes.title: Bug Fixes | Private Relays
notes.notes:
[b]Private Relay Bug Fixes[/b]
-The port and IP information will now disappear when the start button is pressed.
-The "host relay" text will now disable when the host button is pressed.

notes.title: Announcement | Testing doors not opening.
notes.notes:
[b]Announcement[/b]
I haven't been able to reproduce the doors not opening bug, so it's been really hard to figure out what's causing it to happen. If you're someone that's consistently encountering the doors not opening bug, and are interested in getting it fixed, I'd like to get in a game with you. If I'm able to be in your game when it happens, I might be able to figure out what's causing it and fix it. You can contact me by responding to this post. In the meantime, disconnecting and creating a new match should be a way to get around the bug for now.

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
Using the "Basic Combo" ability right when the "Dash" ability ends no longer causes your attack to not happen.

notes.title: Workaround | Doors not opening.
notes.notes: -A "warp to host" button has been added to the escape menu. This can be used to teleport past a door that will not open. (The previous attempt to fix the doors not opening bug did not work. Until a solution can be found, this is how you can get around it.)

notes.title: Bugfix | Unable to join game bug.
notes.notes: -Clicking the disconnect button on the game over screen or stage complete screen no longer prevents you from joining matches.

notes.title: Update | View games in progress.
notes.notes: -Games in progress will now show up on the match list.

notes.title: Bugfix | Doors not opening.
notes.notes:
[b]Bugs[/b]
-A possible fix for the problem of doors not opening has been added.

[b]Abilities[/b]
-The Strike ability can cancel the shield ability.
-Attacking after using the Boost ability is more consistent.
-The Drone Revival ability can animation cancel other abilities, allowing you to place it in the correct direction during another action.

notes.title: Bugfix | PVP Lobby
notes.notes: -Dying in the lobby, while a PVP stage is selected, will no longer teleport you to the PVP arena.
